01 / The game

Character Design for Shapeshifters Duel

Current artwork, animation references and a first exploration

2D heroic fantasyCharacter exploration19 November 2026

You are the wizard.

Recruit a small band of fantasy fighters and place them on a board. They fight automatically; you intervene by transforming allies or enemies into a random new form. A shield-bearing guardian can become a rabbit. A new body means a new combat role.

Playful, mischievous, a little absurd.

We want expressive characters and surprising magical accidents, with clear tactical action underneath. The current game is a single-player duel against an AI wizard.

Super Auto Pets informs the playful atmosphere; Teamfight Tactics informs the board and automatic combat. Neither dictates the character style.

02 / What exists today

Two families. One cast apart.

The prototype has 12 fantasy fighters and 12 animal forms. These drawings establish identities and roles; the visual style is open to exploration.

Fantasy fighters

Animal forms

Blue and red circles identify the two teams. Save the character reference sheet.

→

A useful starting pair: Shield Guardian + Rabbit.
Armoured strength versus agility: a solid guardian and a quick, unexpectedly fierce rabbit. The rabbit should look less powerful, but still ready to fight. Keep their on-board size comparable so both remain easy to read. This is one possible transformation, not a fixed pair.

03 / Animation

An approach to explore together.

For the prototype, I move, rotate and scale static drawings to keep the workload small. Dedicated character animations could be interesting too, with a different scope. These clips show the current approach.

01. Fight & bounce

Short lunges, hit flashes and hops on the bard's beat give combat rhythm and impact.

02. Change bodies

Golden light marks a friendly transformation; a purple vortex marks an enemy hex. The new form should read immediately.

03. Exit like a rocket

Defeated creatures spin off the board trailing smoke: exaggerated, comic defeat.

04 / Your first exploration

Explore an art direction.

Suggest a visual direction for the game, then try it out through a Shield Guardian and a Rabbit.

What to share

  1. A few words on your art direction and animation. What would suit the game's mood, stay manageable for a jam, and be fun for you to make? Would you keep the current animation approach or add a few simple character animations? No animation to produce.
  2. A visual reference. A game screenshot, a few reference images or a small mock-up to explain your direction. Choose one format.
  3. A first take on the Guardian and the Rabbit. One pose each, readable at gameplay size. Rough sketches are welcome.

Up to 1–2 hours.

Less is welcome. Keep it light rather than polishing or expanding the scope.

If another fantasy fighter / animal combination inspires you more, suggest it before starting.

Open to exploration: style, palette, proportions and expression, within a 2D heroic fantasy world. Top-down or slight perspective can be explored.

This is a small game jam project: a chance to get to know each other and see if we enjoy working together, with no pressure to carry on afterwards.

If I'd like to use your work in the game, I'll talk it through with you first. And of course, if we decide to work together, you'll be credited on the game's itch.io page, as I've always done for my game jams.
